title: COMEX Silver Futures Price Trends
takeaway: COMEX silver futures prices have significantly increased since early 2023.

data.label: COMEX Silver Futures Price - August 2024
data.evidence: As of today, August 6, 2024, the COMEX silver futures contract is trading around $32.40 per ounce.

narration: The COMEX silver futures price has risen significantly from its low of $21.50 in early 2023 to approximately $32.40 as of August 6, 2024. This increase reflects a combination of factors including inflation concerns and geopolitical uncertainty.
